description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The value is generated by the client and must be unique among different requests. The value can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length.
The ID of the target cluster.

descriptions.zh: > 在ACK集群上安装采集器前，需要先调用该接口，在目标集群上安装Elasticsearch Operator。
descriptions.en: > Before installing a collector on an ACK cluster, call this operation to install the Elasticsearch Operator on the target cluster.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun elasticsearch install-ack-operator --cluster-id c79acd3fbf462423fb6450e513bb60000 --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF0000 --biz-body example-string --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
